newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia has lower trade deficit to April 97.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia has lower trade deficit to April 97.

text.p: Tunisia's trade deficit fell to 718.8 million dinars ($665.4 million) during the first four months of 1997 from 772.0 million dinars a year earlier, official statistics showed on Wednesday.
Exports rose 14.2 percent year on year to 1,916.1 million dinars and imports were up by 7.5 percent to 2,634.9 million dinars.

Agriculture and food exports rose by 89.5 percent to 176.6 million dinars compared to 93.2 million dinars last year. Better climatic conditions for agriculture made food imports, including that of cereals, amount to 289.1 million dinars, up by only 1.3 percent.

Exports of textiles, Tunisia's first manufacturing earner of foreign currency, amounted to 981.1 million dinars, up 7.3 percent compared to last year. The sector's imports were 680.1 million dinars, up by 9.8 percent.
Mining and phosphates products exports rose 11.4 percent to 199.4 million dinars from 179 million dinars.
Energy sector exports were193.5 million dinars, up by 27.8 percent compared to last year, and imports 210.8 million dinars, up by 18.3 percent. ($=1.08 dinar)
